# Scroll: a rolled parchment 0.46 m long (along x), 0.16 m thick, dark end caps and a lime seal band.
# Origin: on the floor. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Paper --base-color 0.7020 0.7647 0.5725 --no-slot
material new Cap --base-color 0.3059 0.2941 0.3529 --no-slot
material new Seal --base-color 0.5098 0.6510 0.2549 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Roll --vertices 8 --radius 0.08 --depth 0.38 --location 0 0 0.08
set rotation 0 90 0
apply --rotation
material assign Paper
add mesh cylinder --name CapR --vertices 8 --radius 0.09 --depth 0.05 --location -0.2 0 0.08
set rotation 0 90 0
apply --rotation
material assign Cap
add mesh cylinder --name CapL --vertices 8 --radius 0.09 --depth 0.05 --location 0.2 0 0.08
set rotation 0 90 0
apply --rotation
material assign Cap
add mesh cylinder --name Seal --vertices 8 --radius 0.095 --depth 0.08 --location 0 0 0.08
set rotation 0 90 0
apply --rotation
material assign Seal
select all
shade flat
export scroll.glb
